dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What was wrong with the old clothes?

dialogues.speaker: Hunza
dialogues.text: Eh, that kind of thing happens all the time! You can't really do extreme sports without accepting that things will get damaged or broken. In the end, it's just a change of clothes. I can afford that much.

dialogues.speaker: Hunza
dialogues.text: Still, I've gotta admit, it was pretty wild skateboarding on a mountain crest less than half a meter wide without any protective gear.

dialogues.speaker: Hunza
dialogues.text: Thankfully, I had my most faithful and considerate Saurian sidekick with me! Katari has always been there for me... Wait, where did he go?

dialogues.speaker: Hunza
dialogues.text: Weird... I could have sworn he was with me just a moment ago!
